messages:
maya (PM): Ok team — new ask from ACME: they need upgrades with preserved customer IPs and minimal netops intervention. want a proposal for installer-side plugins + a staged rollback safe path. :thinking_face:

sam (eng): Agree this keeps coming up. Two approaches: 1) installer-plugin that talks to customer IPAM/DNS via a small adapter (runs with customer creds). 2) rely on netops pre-provisioned aliases + our handoff. Both have tradeoffs.

leo (product): Tradeoffs: (1) reduces field work but increases our surface to support customer's networking APIs; (2) simpler for us but heavier for customer. Need launch criteria if we pick (1).

rita (field): From field: customers prefer option (1) when they have many tenants and ephemeral IPs. Biggest ask: preserve external IPs during hot upgrades (no client-side reconnect). Without that they reject upgrades.

sam (eng): Technical sketch for plugin path: plugin runs in customer env (k8s Job/daemonset) and does a 3-step upgrade handshake: 1) allocate temp endpoints, 2) copy KV caches + establish backward-compatible routing, 3) async swap and healthcheck. If swap fails -> revert DNS to previous endpoints.

maya (PM): Can you write minimal config example we could ship in installer? That helps legal/security review re: scopes.

sam (eng): Sure — draft: ```yaml
plugin: ip-preserve-adapter
version: v1
credentials: /var/run/creds/ipam-token
mode: staged
preflight: true
rollback-on-failure: true
```
Note: adapter only needs token-limited scope: allocate/release records, update A/AAAA, TTL adjust.

nate (sre): We need SLO/obs guardrails. For rollout: require healthchecks + 5m steady state before DNS swap. Telemetry: plugin must emit events to our onboarded logging endpoint and also expose /ready /metrics.

rita (field): Also operational ask: document a short runbook for customers where their netops can opt-out and do manual handoff. Some customers will not allow third-party update rights.

leo (product): Proposed launch MVP checklist (for decision meeting):
- Plugin binary + helm chart (minimal config)
- Adapter auth pattern (token + least privilege)
- Installer flag: `--enable-ip-preserve` (defaults off)
- Observability contract (events + metrics)
- Field runbook + rollback playbook
- Legal sign-off on network-access contract

maya (PM): Prioritization ask: customers blocking this are 2 enterprise logos worth ~80k ARR each if we ship within Q1. If we go plugin route that's ~3 sprint effort (eng + security review). Manual handoff route is 1 sprint but loses some customers.

sam (eng): Implementation risks: testing matrix explodes: k8s distributions, IPAM providers (Infoblox, AWS, OnPrem), BGP vs NATed setups. Mitigation: ship adapters for AWS Route53 + a generic HTTP-IPAM shim, mark others as incubating.

nate (sre): On rollback mechanics: ensure KV cache serialization is backward compatible. If not, fallback to cold-start with graceful traffic drain via client-side retries. Need an eval harness.

maya (PM): Decision proposal for tomorrow: pick plugin path with two-phase launch:
Phase 1 (MVP): Route53 + generic IPAM shim, helm chart, observability, legal template.
Phase 2: Add Infoblox adapter, BGP-preserve path, runbook templates for netops-opt-out.

rita (field): :+1: field ok with that sequencing. Can we tag one pilot customer to test Phase 1 in March?

leo (product): I'll propose ACME as pilot if legal signs the network access addendum.

deploy-bot: release-checklist reminder: "please attach installer flag docs to PR and include metrics contract in telemetry spec"

maya (PM): Great. Action items: Sam — estimate sprints for MVP + risks (due EOD Tue). Nate — draft observability contract + eval harness requirements (EOD Wed). Leo/Rita — start pilot outreach and legal kickoff. I'll capture this in roadmap doc and escalate to execs if customers confirmed. :rocket:
